label: verify-t1-reporter-crit

claims.claim: Eco1C2G2T2 holdout is a re-measurement of largely the same constructs as the calibration library (15/18 names shared, 13/18 identical cassettes, 9+ of 13 pairs identical to calibration pairs), so not independent.
claims.source_says: Own parse of both UCF files (hashes match): 20 vs 18 gates, 15 shared names, 13 identical cassettes, 0 parameter-identical, 13 strict pairs of which 9 have both gates shared with identical cassettes; units RPUG vs REU.
claims.note: Every count reproduces; the 9 of 13 figure matches my count of pairs whose two gates are both identical-cassette shared gates.

claims.claim: Designer's reported numbers are correct apart from the pair count (10 not 9).
claims.note: Pair count and per-pair dn, Kfold, S all reproduce; I did not see the designer's file, so the 'apart from 9' premise is unchecked.

claims.claim: P5 false (LexA pair differs in output promoter, in-scope yeast pairs 0); P2 redundant with P1 and passes 48 percent of unrelated-n pairs; P3 r>=0.80 passes at r=0.972 and also under heavy noise; only P1 restated is a real test.
claims.source_says: P1_LexA outputs pLexA1_a/b (113 nt) vs P2_LexA pLexA2_a/b (115 nt), sequences differ; strict yeast pairs 0. Cross-repressor: 177 pairs, 108 with Kfold>=2, 48.1% have S>=6, median S 5.45.
claims.note: P5 and P2 numbers reproduce exactly, but I did not re-run the cytometry refit (r=0.972) or noise simulation, and 'only P1 is a real test' is judgment.

claims.claim: Data do not support pure log-translation: ymax up to 1.74x and ymin up to 5.5x within RBS-only pairs, and pair-level n differences within fitting noise (0 of 10 refit z>2).
claims.source_says: E. coli calibration pairs: ymax ratio up to 1.74 (P1/P3 PhlF), 5 of 10 above 1.15; ymin ratio up to 3.0 (QacR), 6 of 10 at or above 2.0. Yeast 5.5x and refit z not checked.
claims.note: The ymax and ymin ratios in E. coli reproduce, but the 5.5x yeast ymin and the refit z-score claim were not verified.

overall: The four key claims mostly reproduce from the public Cello UCF files: structure counts, pair counts, dn, Kfold, S, ymax/ymin ratios, the LexA output-promoter difference and the 48.1% null pass rate all match my own recomputation. Not re-checked: the cytometry refit (r=0.972, z-scores), the noise simulations and the 5.5x yeast ymin ratio, which is why two claims are partly.
